notes: Expands gradient lettering to every editable text group: work titles, author/byline, summary, main fic text, fic-info/metadata labels, notes, all tag categories, all Stats & Metadata values, chapter titles, and Interface text. Each text group keeps its solid color as a fallback and gets a shortcut into the shared Gradient Studio, with preview, AO3-safe CSS export, CSS edit-state round-trip, and per-skin persistence. Interface gradient coverage now includes AO3 navigation/actions, preview headings/counts, comment UI, and footer text. Adds the built-in Gilded Ivory gradient: #FFFDF7 → #F4E8C8 → #D9B967 → #A77A2C at 135deg.
